story.iWant: clear PluginManifest schema with required and optional fields
story.soThat: I know what metadata to include in my plugin
story.tasks: - Define PluginManifest interface with required fields - Add optional marketplace metadata fields - Define plugin capabilities structure - Add configuration schema support - Include security and permission declarations - Define compatibility constraints - Document all fields with JSDoc - Export types from plugin namespace - Add usage examples

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - PluginManifest interface with all required fields defined - Optional marketplace metadata fields (tags, homepage, repository, etc.) - Plugin capabilities structure for feature discovery - Configuration schema support for runtime validation - Security and permission declarations - Compatibility constraints (engine version, dependencies) - JSDoc documentation for all fields - Type exports from plugin namespace - Examples showing manifest usage - Compilation without errors

story-context.constraints: - Follow NPM package.json conventions for metadata fields - Version must be semver-compliant - Plugin type must be from defined enum (provider|guard|evaluator|logger|worker) - Configuration schema should follow JSON Schema spec - Permissions array for security declarations - Engine version for compatibility constraints - Support both required and optional fields - Marketplace fields (pricing, support, screenshots) optional

item.name: PluginManifest
item.signature: Required: name, version, pluginType, displayName, description. Optional: author, license, repository, capabilities, permissions, configSchema, etc.

tests.standards: Jest unit tests, validate required vs optional fields, test semver validation
tests.ideas: - Test minimal manifest with only required fields - Test full manifest with all optional fields - Validate semver format for version field - Test plugin type enum values - Verify capability flags are boolean - Test configuration schema validation - Test NPM-style metadata compatibility
